To secure your assets and physical safety, first, **diversify investments towards tangible, resilient sectors** less exposed to geopolitical and climatic shocks, while carefully navigating the transformative yet volatile AI landscape. Third, **maintain acute situational awareness** of both regional geopolitical developments and localized seismic threats to enable timely and effective responses.
